evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and alters the parameters, help, and client parsing for the generateblock RPC in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Expands the generateblock RPC to support multiple coinbase outputs, custom payout amounts, and automatic mempool transaction inclusion. Reviewers noted external interest for simulating multi-payout mining pools (such as Ocean and Braidpool), addressing a test tooling gap without affecting mainnet RPC compatibility.
